description: This file defines the DynamoDBMembershipHelper class, which provides a static method to parse a data connection string and populate a DynamoDBClusteringOptions object with configuration parameters such as service, table name, access key, secret key, and capacity units. The class is part of the Orleans clustering DynamoDB implementation, specifically assisting in configuration parsing for DynamoDB-based clustering.

classes.name: DynamoDBMembershipHelper
classes.description: Helper class with a static method to parse a data connection string and populate clustering options for DynamoDB

methods.name: ParseDataConnectionString
methods.description: Parses the given connection string to extract configuration settings and sets them on the provided DynamoDBClusteringOptions object.
